answer.says: That is a correction of the ledger. I had assumed the samosa was part of the transaction, but you have separated the particular need from the general one. I will pay for the cup only, as is just. Thank you, Sunil.
answer.thought: The samosa sits untouched, a surplus I did not order. Sunil has corrected the arithmetic of my hunger, distinguishing the necessary drink from the unnecessary snack. It is a small act of prudence, or perhaps just Delhi's way of managing waste. I accept the correction and the drink.
